notes.title: Fairly significant revamp to first area!
notes.notes:
To anyone playing the pre-release version, the first area has received a fairly significant revamp. A couple of new enemy types and a new boss.

In addition, one challenge has now been replaced with a more exiting one, as well as some important fixes/balances.

Lastly, events can now randomly occur in each area to spice things up!

Enjoy.
